text:
Part 3 verified:
- Test commit `9dba20b` comes before the implementation commit `1dc0dd8`. The implementation commit did not touch the test file. Nothing was removed, loosened or skipped.
- `parseEvent(input: unknown): Result<RewindEvent>` wraps all work in `try/catch`, so it never throws. Tests cover `null`, a number, a string, a random object, circular payloads, deep trees and throwing getters.
- Every one of the 12 event types has a valid case and an invalid case with an exact `path` and `message`.
- Hand-written guards, no new dependency. Bundle impact (3.1 KB min+gzip for the shared ESM) is in the PR note. ADR 0006 and ADR 0007 added and listed in `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- CI is green on `1dc0dd8` (lint, typecheck, test, build). Commits are authored as the owner with the Cursor co-author trailer.
